name: The IIWF Golden Grapple Awards
epitaph: The federation's own year-end honors show, staged live as a banquet broadcast complete with a sung roll-call of the active roster; its 1997 ceremony was self-declared the "Second Annual," naming a first 1996 edition this collection does not hold.
